name: Shuryomin
source:
Find'em and hunt'em down.

I was involved in an accident occurred during a voyage, and drifted ashore at an isolated island with 3 female students. Explore the island and find them all!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029945.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

找到他们并追捕他们。

我在一次航行中遭遇意外，与3名女学生漂流到孤岛。探索岛屿并找到全部！
